description: The Economist Big Mac index for a country: the local Big Mac price, the dollar exchange rate, the dollar price, and the raw and GDP-adjusted over/under-valuation of the currency against USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and CNY, for one index release (default the latest) or the full history since 2000. Omit country to list every country in one release. Source: The Economist big-mac-data (MIT).

country.description: Country name as The Economist spells it ("Switzerland", "Britain", "Euro area"), ISO3 code ("CHE") or currency code ("CHF"). Omit for all countries.

date.description: Index release: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or "latest" (default). Resolves to the latest release on or before it.

history.description: With a country: return every release since 2000 instead of one (oldest first). Ignores date.

name: big_mac_index
title: Big Mac Index
